# `lakana invite`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana invite [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Invite people by a link that creates their account (ADMIN).

## `lakana invite create`

Usage: `lakana invite create [OPTIONS] {name}`

Invite a new person as NAME; prints the link to send them.

The link works once, for 7 days, and creates the account NAME with no rights. It stops working if you are deactivated or lose the ADMIN role first. Confirm with the person that they signed up before you grant roles. Only the link goes to stdout.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--display-name` | text | none | The person's name as the interface shows it. |

## `lakana invite list`

Usage: `lakana invite list [OPTIONS]`

List the open invites (never their links).

## `lakana invite withdraw`

Usage: `lakana invite withdraw [OPTIONS] {ID}`

Withdraw the open invite ID; its link stops working and its name is free again.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ID` | text | required |  |
